[P2] Require coverage for default Bedrock client reuse

Replacing `??=` with `=` leaves the added assertions unchanged: the client-reuse tests cover only the three decider transports, while the Bedrock recovery test makes only one successful call. Consequently, constructing a new Bedrock client for every request would go undetected. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the client-lifecycle design and either reuse the tested `lazyClient` helper or require two successful calls through one default `llm()` instance to construct exactly one client.
